parts.text:
Foundation Responsive continuation is complete. Here's the honest split:

**Applied (2 acknowledged batches, now r1#10; earlier theme/header/drawer/welcome/nav/projects untouched)**
- Card headings "Projects" / "Milestones" (h3, margin reset).
- `vict.pattern.carousel` in the Milestones card: `slides`→`state.milestoneSlides` (3 items), `index`→`state.carouselIndex`, `indexChange`→setState `carouselIndex` (controlled pair, Previous/Next built in).
- Inert `vict.media.vector` (teal geometric mark, `decorative: true`). One note: the instance recorded revision "1" in source while the active contract is @2 — host-validated as applied.
- Selection note as a real `p` with two text children; bound text node →`state.selectedProject` (fixes the refused bindText-on-element attempt; no invented icons/searchIcon props).
- Narrow layout via existing `cond-narrow` (studio-screen ≤760px): grid collapses to one column, screen padding 16px.

**Observed (one fresh capture, r1#10)**
- Teal theme, welcome, header, nav tab row (Overview active) all intact; "Projects" heading, search field, "3 results"; Milestones card shows "Kickoff — Sprint 24 scope locked" with Previous / "1 / 3" / Next controls. Capture covered only ~580 of ~969px: carousel indicators, the vector, and the note are **below the fold — source-verified, not visually confirmed**.

**Untested**
- Carousel Previous/Next clicks, indexChange→state round-trip, swipe/keyboard; drawer/nav interactions (pre-existing); narrow-layout rendering (would require a narrower preview width — I can't scroll or change it); saving remains yours.
